latestVersion.changelog:
bring-add 1.0.0 initial release

- CLI tool to add items to Bring! shopping lists.
- Supports single item, batch, stdin/file, and interactive input modes.
- Includes dry-run preview and JSON output for scripting.
- Provides commands to list available shopping lists.
- Flexible item parsing with specification support (e.g., "Milk 1L").
